title.narrative: Supporting UNEP in the Implementation of the 3DEN Initiative

description.narrative:
UNEP has been appointed as implementing partner of the Digital Demand-Driven Electricity Networks Initiative (3DEN), which aims to foster electricity system innovation and effective utilization of renewable energy resources through policy, regulation, technology and investment guidance.
UNOPS project specific objective is to support UNEP in the management and disbursement of the grants envelope allocated to the pilot projects. 
The project will also contribute to the procurement of energy efficient renewable energy equipment, which will be piloted on a residential building in Cairo, Egypt.
